# Intermediate Representation — Magnet_Feed
Station number: 1
Description: Feeds magnets from a dial stack: hold-down clamps the stack, vertical shuttle lifts it, horizontal shuttle presents the top magnet (coin-changer style). Retries presentation up to 3x on missing magnet, then declares the stack exhausted and requests a dial index. Top retainer holds the magnet down during every horizontal shuttle move (extend before horizontal extend, retract after shuttle-over) so it cannot magnetize and flip up.

## Devices
- [PneumaticLinearActuator] VerticalShuttle "Vertical_Shuttle" sensorArrangement="1-sensor (Ret only)" homePosition="Retract" axisNumber=1 extTimerMs=500 retTimerMs=500 engageTimerMs=300 disengageTimerMs=300 vacOnTimerMs=300 hasEject=false timerMs=1000
- [PneumaticLinearActuator] HorizontalShuttle "Horizontal_Shuttle" sensorArrangement="1-sensor (Ret only)" homePosition="Retract" axisNumber=1 extTimerMs=500 retTimerMs=500 engageTimerMs=300 disengageTimerMs=300 vacOnTimerMs=300 hasEject=false timerMs=1000
- [PneumaticLinearActuator] HoldDown "Hold_Down" sensorArrangement="1-sensor (Ret only)" homePosition="Retract" axisNumber=1 extTimerMs=500 retTimerMs=500 engageTimerMs=300 disengageTimerMs=300 vacOnTimerMs=300 hasEject=false timerMs=1000
- [PneumaticLinearActuator] TopRetainer "Top_Retainer" sensorArrangement="1-sensor (Ret only)" homePosition="Retract" axisNumber=1 extTimerMs=300 retTimerMs=500 engageTimerMs=300 disengageTimerMs=300 vacOnTimerMs=300 hasEject=false timerMs=1000
- [DigitalSensor] MagnetSensor "Magnet_Present" sensorArrangement="" homePosition="" axisNumber=1 extTimerMs=500 retTimerMs=500 engageTimerMs=300 disengageTimerMs=300 vacOnTimerMs=300 hasEject=false timerMs=1000

    action: Retract -> HorizontalShuttle (advanceCondition={"type":"onComplete"})
    action: Extend -> TopRetainer
- State 19: "Magnet Ready"
    action: Decide -> _decision (decisionType="signal" signalId="id_aismt" signalName="Magnet_Taken" signalSource="Magnet_Pick → Magnet Taken" signalSmName="Magnet_Pick" signalType="state" nodeMode="decide" conditionType="sensorOn" sensorInputType="bool" exitCount=2 exit1Label="On" exit2Label="Off" exitLabelsCustomized=false retryEnabled=false ptEnabled=false updatePartTracking=false autoOpenPopup=false conditions=[{"ref":"signal_id_aismt","tag":"","label":"Magnet_Taken","inputType":"bool","conditionType":"on","signalType":"state","group":"Magnet_Pick → Magnet Taken"}])

## MACHINE SPEC (mechanical intent — compile the coordination)
This section is AUTHORITATIVE intent authored by the mechanical engineer.
Synthesize the signals, waits, exits, and cross-station handshakes that
realize it. EVERY wait you create must have an exit for every partner
failure mode listed here PLUS a timeout — no exitless waits.

Station purpose: Feed magnets one at a time from the indexed stack to the pick station

### Device purposes
- Vertical_Shuttle: raises the stack
- Horizontal_Shuttle: presents one magnet coin-changer style
- Hold_Down: clamps the stack
- Top_Retainer: stops magnets flipping during shuttle moves
- Magnet_Present: confirms one is presented

### Outcome rules (verbatim — each one needs a reachable path in the program)
- WHEN: no magnet at sensor after shuttle over -> DO: shuttle back and re-present [retry up to 3x]. WHEN RETRIES RUN OUT: unclamp, lower shuttle, request next stack
- WHEN: pick lost the magnet -> DO: present a fresh one.
- WHEN: pick gave up -> DO: unclamp, lower shuttle, request next stack. WHEN RETRIES RUN OUT: unclamp, lower shuttle, request next stack

### Relationships declared by this station
- feeds -> Magnet_Pick: one magnet at a time, on demand
- requests-index -> Dial_Index: when stack is exhausted

### Reciprocal declarations by partner stations (their side of the handshake)
- Dial_Index (station 0) declares signals -> this station: indexes a fresh stack into place when the feeder requests it
- Magnet_Pick (station 2) declares consumes -> this station: receives one magnet at a time from the feeder, on demand
